interface.shortDescription: Professional charts, diagrams and dashboards via matplotlib, ECharts, D3 and Mermaid with scene-based routing.
interface.longDescription: GLM Charts packages the proven glmcharts skill under the unified glm- plugin naming (review decision D6; skill name unchanged). The skill routes any chart request to the right engine — matplotlib/seaborn for data charts, ECharts/D3 for interactive dashboards, Mermaid for flow and sequence diagrams — with a scene-based routing framework, professional color systems, anti-overlap rules and publication-ready output. This is the baseline plugin already verified end-to-end in ChatGPT (Codex).
